services.name: Humidity check with readings
services.blurb: Temperature, humidity and dew point measured in each room, then plotted on one chart.

services.name: Whole-home dehumidifiers
services.blurb: A dehumidifier tied into your ducts pulls the clammy feel out without freezing the house.

services.name: AC repair
services.blurb: No cooling or weak cooling diagnosed with gauges and a meter, explained in plain words.

services.name: Right-sized AC replacement
services.blurb: A room-by-room load calculation so the new unit runs long enough to dry the air.

services.name: Heat pump installation
services.blurb: Variable-speed heat pumps that cool slowly, dry deeply and heat through Houston's freezes.

services.name: Evaporator coil cleaning
services.blurb: Dirty indoor coils cleaned so air moves across them and water drains instead of pooling.

services.name: Drain line and pan service
services.blurb: Slime cleared, pans checked for rust, float switches tested before water reaches the ceiling.

services.name: Attic duct repair
services.blurb: Crushed or sweating attic ducts fixed and wrapped, so they stop dripping onto the drywall.

services.name: Furnace repair
services.blurb: Gas furnaces brought back for the few cold weeks, with a carbon monoxide reading noted.

reviews.text: Thermostat said 72 and the house still felt like a swamp. Tasha measured a dew point of 64 in the bedroom and showed me on her chart why turning it down made it worse. The dehumidifier fixed it in a week.
reviews.name: Priya S.

reviews.text: Two companies wanted to put in a 5-ton. Wetbulb did the room-by-room numbers and installed a 3.5 variable-speed. It runs longer and quieter, and the closets stopped smelling musty.
reviews.name: Greg H.

reviews.text: Brown spot spreading on the ceiling under the attic unit. The pan was rusted through and the float switch was never wired. Fixed both and sent me photos of the new pan.
reviews.name: Lorena M.

reviews.text: I liked that the humidity check came with a printout: every room, temperature, humidity, dew point. The upstairs office was the outlier and the fix was a damper, not a new system.
reviews.name: Ken O.

reviews.text: After the storm in July our AC came back on but barely cooled. They found a burnt contactor and a coil full of grime, cleaned it on the spot, and the vents went from 66 to 54.
reviews.name: Darius T.

reviews.text: Scheduling took a few days in peak season, which was frustrating. The coil cleaning itself was careful, they put down drop cloths in the hall and showed me the before and after photos.
reviews.name: Wendy C.

prices.note: credited if you go ahead with the repair
